headline: European Gas Scramble Drives Up Asian and European LNG Benchmark Prices
summary: Low European gas inventories and disrupted Qatari LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz have pushed Europe to bid up LNG cargoes, lifting benchmark prices across both Europe and Asia.
why: Liquefied natural gas is a critical source of fuel and power generation for Europe and Asia, where supply shortages directly affect industrial costs and inflation.

impacts.name: Natural Gas
impacts.why: European and Asian benchmark gas and LNG prices rose due to tight global supply and Europe's lowest pre-winter storage levels in over a decade.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Benchmark natural gas and LNG prices advanced across Europe and Asia as low European inventory levels and Strait of Hormuz supply constraints tightened global cargo availability.
